summary: Insomniac's alternate-history alien-invasion shooter series, covering the PS3 trilogy and handheld side entries from Bend Studio and Nihilistic.

entries.title: Resistance: Fall of Man
entries.definitive_edition: PS3 release, preferably updated/digital where available

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Fall of Man is a PS3-only launch-era shooter with no modern port documented; later European digital versions include updates/map packs.
primary.how_to_play: Play through RPCS3 if compatible or original PS3 hardware; online multiplayer servers are shut down.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS3 release; later EU digital version included updates/map packs.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Campaign remains playable, but online multiplayer servers closed in 2014.

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Resistance 2 is a PS3-only mainline sequel with no modern port documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play through RPCS3 if compatible or original PS3 hardware; online multiplayer/co-op servers are shut down.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single-player remains available, but online multiplayer/co-op servers closed in 2014.

entries.title: Resistance: Retribution

primary.why: Retribution's 2024 PS4/PS5 release is the current official route for the PSP side story.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use PPSSPP only for original PSP comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for current official access by PS4/PS5 release.

all_releases.fidelity: PSP Classics release with modern PlayStation access.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS4/PS5 release is the current recommended route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Originally a PSP game; modern release remains an emulated classic rather than a remake.

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware for native 3D/Move features.

primary.why: Resistance 3 is a PS3-only mainline sequel and the first in the series to support 3D and PlayStation Move.
primary.how_to_play: Play through RPCS3 if compatible or original PS3 hardware; online servers are shut down.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS3 release with 3D and PlayStation Move support.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Campaign remains available, but online servers closed in 2014; 3D/Move support requires matching hardware.

primary.why: Burning Skies is the Vita-only FPS entry and the latest original release in the series.
